notes.title: The plants and pats update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It’s been a while since our last update, and I want to assure you we have been busy in the background working in the game, more specifically working on our demo! We are very happy to bring it to you, but first we’ll be running a private playtest in our Discord server soon 💜✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/4d5a3d003370c813d80fffe85ea61706ead35065.gif[/img]

Some features of our demo include:

- Changing objects colours, and sizes.
- Cosmo, a cat you can pat! <3
- Completing tasks at your own pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/e8a843eabf17fdef812a9385ad8fc84813a6add4.gif[/img]

At the moment we are remaking our plants so they feel extra cosy and special!
I think they make the spaces feel so alive ☺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/7d6c79f3ceb9d40893077ec46d1a02363c47e4ac.gif[/img]

If you’d like to try the game before others, pet Cosmo and help us shape it into something truly magical, you can join our discord for closed playtests! 💜✨

Discord: https://discord.gg/f4A75GEK5m

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/f88db512799d5e3bb58885eea90ac16c84ea8720.gif[/img]
